name: Pizza Solutions
old_description: Peerless Multi-Deck Mexican Gas Deck Ovens are simply the best on the market. Since 1919, these workhorse ovens have served the industry as a world-wide standard for economy and value — continuously updated to keep these units up to current industry standards in terms of materials, burners and controls.
about:
Pizza Solutions is based in Nicholasville, Kentucky, and traces its origins to 1919. The company operates as a distributor of commercial kitchen equipment, though details about its founding ownership or early history are not publicly disclosed.

The firm supplies a broad range of equipment for foodservice operations, including conveyor and deck ovens, refrigeration units, prep tables, sinks, dough processing machines, ventilation, and furniture. It carries brands such as Edge Ovens, Moretti Forni, Arctic, Frosty Factory, Tecnoeka, Flash Furniture, and Serv-Ware. Services include warranty support, financing through a partner called APPROVE, and free freight quotes.

Pizza Solutions targets multiple segments: pizzerias and Italian restaurants, fast-casual concepts, Mexican restaurants, convenience stores, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, hospitality and lodging, and pub, grill, and family-dining establishments. The company also serves concession and convenience-store operators.

The company emphasizes post-sale service, stating that it guarantees satisfaction with service after the sale. It positions itself as a one-stop shop for restaurant and C-store equipment, highlighting its ability to deliver quality ovens and equipment for Mexican restaurants and other segments.
